records.title: AgentWatcher: A Rule-based Prompt Injection Monitor
records.reason: AgentWatcher attributes output-relevant context spans and applies a rule-based monitor; restricting the monitor to a small context is intended to scale detection to long contexts and cut monitor computation. The paper is a prompt-injection defense, not an inference-system optimization, and does not quantify general serving savings.

records.title: Lightweight large language model based hierarchical federated learning for B5G enabled IoT intrusion detection networks
records.reason: Publisher title and abstract identify hierarchical federated learning for IoT intrusion detection. The LLM is used in a cyber-detection application; no inference optimization or serving method is indicated.

records.title: Tokenization Tradeoffs in Structured EHR Foundation Models
records.reason: The paper compares tokenization strategies for structured EHR foundation models and evaluates downstream task performance. Tokenization/context representation may affect sequence size, but the study does not establish a direct inference-efficiency improvement.

records.title: Image Generation with a Sphere Encoder
records.reason: Sphere Encoder addresses image-generation representation/quality. The method and evaluation do not involve LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Perplexity Cannot Always Tell Right from Wrong
records.reason: This paper studies whether perplexity can identify correctness; its experiments assess model evaluation signals, not inference compute or runtime optimization.
